tool_input.description: Check domain tags via system function on individual tables
tool_input.sql:
SELECT OBJECT_NAME, TAG_VALUE, LEVEL
FROM TABLE(KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TAG_REFERENCES('KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.DIM_CLIENT', 'TABLE'))
WHERE TAG_NAME = 'DOMAIN'
UNION ALL
SELECT OBJECT_NAME, TAG_VALUE, LEVEL
FROM TABLE(KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TAG_REFERENCES('KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.DIM_ADVISOR', 'TABLE'))
WHERE TAG_NAME = 'DOMAIN'
UNION ALL

FROM TABLE(KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TAG_REFERENCES('KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.DIM_ACCOUNT', 'TABLE'))
WHERE TAG_NAME = 'DOMAIN'
UNION ALL
SELECT OBJECT_NAME, TAG_VALUE, LEVEL
FROM TABLE(KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TAG_REFERENCES('KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.DIM_SECURITY', 'TABLE'))
WHERE TAG_NAME = 'DOMAIN'
UNION ALL
SELECT OBJECT_NAME, TAG_VALUE, LEVEL
FROM TABLE(KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TAG_REFERENCES('KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.FCT_ACCOUNT_VALUE', 'TABLE'))
WHERE TAG_NAME = 'DOMAIN'
UNION ALL
SELECT OBJECT_NAME, TAG_VALUE, LEVEL
FROM TABLE(KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TAG_REFERENCES('KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.FCT_PORTFOLIO_RETURN', 'TABLE'))
